## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (56%)** · Ambiguous: InSitu vs Invasive · Careful review
Invasive carcinoma (43%) remains in the 90% conformal set [F1], and all four simulated frozen-section margins are flagged [F11].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | InSitu 56%, Invasive 43%, Benign <1%, Normal <1% | Closely split; 43% invasive risk |
| Conformal set | InSitu, Invasive (90% target; 90% test coverage, n=132) | Cannot exclude invasive carcinoma |
| Reliability / OOD | 96% reliability, 100% OOD (12/12 regions; error AUROC 70%) [F6] | Atypical distance; no quality flag |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Agree on top class | Independent backbones match each other |
| Similar cases | 40% agreement (2/5 InSitu, 3/5 Invasive; 82%–84% similarity) [F5] | Reference neighbors lean toward invasive |

## Tissue evidence
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (regions 5, 6, 9) · ↓ invasive · Strongest score against invasion (-0.60); AI spot check 12/20 [F2] · Weak
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (regions 3, 7, 8) · context · Elevated descriptive score (-0.56); AI spot check 8/20 [F3] · Weak
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 3, 7, 8) · ↑ invasive · Pushes toward invasion (+0.54), fails AI spot check (0/20) [F4] · Unreliable
- **Tumor necrosis** (regions 2, 6, 9) · ↑ invasive · Pushes toward invasion (+0.43), fails AI spot check (3/20) · Unreliable
- **Neoplastic nuclei (HoVer-Net)** (regions 5, 6, 9) · context · 77% tumor fraction (97th percentile) [F7]; 2489/mm² density (96th) [F8] · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; removing top 3 risk regions drops invasive probability above random (+0.0114, 95% CI 0.0021 to 0.0197).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (+0.0008, 95% CI -0.0088 to 0.0064 includes 0); case leans on unreliable mitoses (0/20) and necrosis (3/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Stromal invasion exists in high-risk regions 10 (96% risk), 11 (56%), or 6 (44%), matching three of five neighbors.
- Simulated frozen-section artifacts mimic nuclear pleomorphism (90th percentile [F9], [F10]), while routine stain orders are blocked.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 10, 11, 6**: Highest heatmap invasive risk (96%, 56%, 44%); verify basement membrane integrity versus stromal invasion.
2. **Regions 5, 6, 9**: Sampled tumor foci (38, 185, 121 neoplastic nuclei); confirm atypical cells remain duct-confined.
3. **Regions 3, 7, 8**: Verify mitoses manually (unreliable 0/20 detector) and inspect flagged perimeter margins (323–538 µm).
